messages.body_plain:
Dear Maeda,

defaults are given in the choosebank() function:

 > args(choosebank)
function (bank = NA, host = "pbil.univ-lyon1.fr", port = 5558,
     server = FALSE, blocking = TRUE, open = "a+", encoding = "",
     verbose = FALSE, timeout = 5, infobank = FALSE, tagbank = NA)

So your firewall should open port 5558 to pbil.univ-lyon1.fr.
It's IP adress is 134.214.32.76

Best,

JLO
